name: Analog
verdict: Analog was launched by G42 in January 2024; its founder says G42 is its biggest investor.
note: Abu Dhabi edge-computing company; on the shoulders of the 2026 UAE Team Emirates XRG kit and an official technology sponsor of UAE Team L'IMAD. Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. G42's stake in Analog isn't disclosed. The state link sits one step up, at G42: Abu Dhabi's state fund Mubadala holds a minority stake there and its chief executive sits on G42's board (G42 is rated on main). The UAE's record is on main (uae-mass-trial-2024, mubadala-uae-convictions-upheld).
